checkpoints.description: [1/1] Build the dupefinder package, CLI, tests, docs and packaging; verify with aikit check

impact_assessment.why: Give the user a genuinely useful, dependency-free utility while exercising the full AIKit project lifecycle.
impact_assessment.benefits: Safe duplicate detection with size-first grouping, SHA-256 verification, JSON output and CI-friendly exit codes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new project, no existing API; dependency: standard library only; concurrency: read-only scan with no shared state; state: writes only inside the project
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the public surface small, test each behavior in temp directories, and run the project Phase 4 gates before committing.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Implemented scanner, hashing, reporting, CLI, packaging and tests; 20 tests pass
[1/1] Phase 4: 4/4 gates pass (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); checklists: passed
[1/1] Add exclude globs, max-depth, CSV output and version; update tests and docs; verify with aikit check

impact_assessment.why: Real scans need to skip noisy folders, bound recursion, and feed scripts without parsing the human report.
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can exclude build caches and logs, limit depth, export one CSV row per duplicate path, and check the installed version.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new CLI flags and one new module; dependency: standard library only; concurrency: read-only scan with no shared state; state: no file writes outside the project
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep filters opt-in, test each flag in temp directories, document matching semantics, and run the project gates before committing.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Implemented exclude filters, max-depth, CSV output, version and tests; 34 tests pass
[1/1] Phase 4: 4/4 gates pass (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); checklists: passed
[1/1] Audit implementation, fix scan-error handling and typing gaps, verify, then publish/push

impact_assessment.why: The audit found a false-success exit code on incomplete scans, an unhandled root failure, and 32 lint findings; the user also asked to push.
impact_assessment.benefits: A scan that could not read everything now fails loudly, a vanished root gets a clean error, and the code is clean under Ruff.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: exit 1 now also means an incomplete scan; dependency: standard library only; concurrency: read-only scan with no shared state; state: publishing creates a GitHub repository and pushes commits
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add regression tests for both failure paths, record ADR-003, run all gates, and publish private unless the user chooses public.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Audited implementation; fixed incomplete-scan exit code, scan failure handling, typing and lint; updated README, ADR-003 and regression tests; 40 tests pass, Ruff clean
[1/1] Phase 4: 4/4 gates pass (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); checklists: passed
[1/1] Add human-readable size bounds and exclude-file support; update tests, docs, version and gates

impact_assessment.why: Real scans need natural size limits and reusable exclusion lists instead of long command lines or manual byte arithmetic.
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can pass --min-size 1MiB and --max-size 500M, and keep shared ignore patterns in a file with comments and blank lines.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new --max-size and --exclude-from flags plus a version bump; dependency: standard library re and pathlib only; concurrency: read-only scan with no shared state; state: no file writes outside the project
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep parsing strict, validate max >= min, test suffixes, comments and unreadable files, document 1024-based units, and run every project gate before committing.
